## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Dhammacakkakathā* ("Discussion of the Wheel of the Teaching") is a text found within the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 2.7). In its doctrinal exposition, it itemizes spiritual faculties and factors of enlightenment, formulating their activation with phrases such as "the faculty of trust is *dhamma*, he sets that *dhamma* in motion" (*saddhindriyaṃ dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavatteti*) [Gethin 2001].
